description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for manipulating and querying ProseMirror editor nodes, selections, and transactions within the Notesnook project, specifically for the ProseMirror-based editor implementation.

methods.name: hasSameAttributes
methods.description: Compares two attribute objects for equality.

methods.name: findSelectedDOMNode
methods.description: Finds the DOM node of the selected element matching specified types.

methods.name: findSelectedNode
methods.description: Finds the ProseMirror node of a specific type at the current selection.

methods.name: findMark
methods.description: Finds a mark of a specific type within a node.

methods.name: selectionToOffset
methods.description: Converts the current selection to a node offset representation.

methods.name: findChildren
methods.description: Finds child nodes of a node that match a predicate.

methods.name: findChildrenByType
methods.description: Finds child nodes of a specific type.

methods.name: findParentNodeOfTypeClosestToPos
methods.description: Finds the closest parent node of a specific type near a position.

methods.name: findParentNodeClosestToPos
methods.description: Finds the closest parent node to a position matching a predicate.

methods.name: hasParentNode
methods.description: Checks if the current selection has a parent node matching a predicate.

methods.name: hasParentNodeOfType
methods.description: Checks if the current selection has a parent node of a specific type.

methods.name: findParentNodeOfType
methods.description: Finds a parent node of a specific type.

methods.name: getParentAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attributes from the parent node of the current selection.

methods.name: getChangedNodeRanges
methods.description: Gets ranges of nodes that have changed in a transaction.

methods.name: getChangedNodes
methods.description: Retrieves nodes that have changed in a transaction, with optional predicate filtering.

methods.name: getExactChangedNodes
methods.description: Retrieves nodes that have exactly changed at specific positions.

methods.name: getDeletedNodes
methods.description: Finds nodes that have been deleted in a transaction.

methods.name: isClickWithinBounds
methods.description: Checks if a mouse or touch event occurred within specified bounds of a node.

methods.name: ensureLeadingParagraph
methods.description: Ensures the first node in a fragment is a paragraph, adding one if necessary.

methods.name: changedDescendants
methods.description: Iterates over descendants of a node that have changed compared to a previous node.
